Maria (Partnerships): Heads up—Snowflake Delta Share + Databricks + Qdrant connector POC kickoff in 2 weeks. Need a quick checklist for schema evolution + large-object (embedding) handling.

Jon (Eng): Good call. Main risk is how we store embeddings in Snowflake and map them to Qdrant vectors. Also delta schema changes during sync.

Keiko (Solutions): Customers will expect automatic schema migration or at least safe failure modes. We should document idempotent ingestion and chunking behavior.

Anil (ML): For embeddings, we recommend one of: base64-encoded arrays in VARIANT, OR separate vector table with float arrays. Qdrant expects floats; conversion details matter.

Jon (Eng): Agreed. Proposed approach: keep original text and metadata in a VARIANT column, store embedding vector in a dedicated column as BINARY for Delta Share, then when pushing to Qdrant run a transform: decode -> float32 array.

Maria (Partnerships): Can we capture that as an explicit compatibility matrix for partners? Snowflake col types -> Delta Share -> Databricks -> Qdrant mapping. I can own the doc but need inputs.

ConnectorBot: Reminder: engineering playbook template available at https://intra.redwood/connector-playbook. Use section 3 for schema mappings. :white_check_mark:

Jon (Eng): I'll paste a sample transform snippet for the connector. Use it in the playbook:
```
# pseudocode
row = read_from_snowflake(row_id)
meta = row['payload_variant']
embed_b64 = row['embed_b64']
vec = np.frombuffer(base64.b64decode(embed_b64), dtype=np.float32)
qdrant.upsert(id=row['id'], vector=vec.tolist(), payload=meta)
```

Keiko (Solutions): Nice. Also add guidance for chunking long documents: store chunk_id + parent_id, recommend 512 token chunks default, keep original doc in VARIANT.

Anil (ML): Add note re: quantized vectors. If partner supplies int8 quantized blobs we need to convert or use Qdrant plugin for quantized indexing. Document fallback to float conversion or tag as "quantized".

Priya (Legal): Quick flag: Delta Share cross-account sharing requires disclosure for customer data flows. Sales/partners must confirm whether embeddings are PII/regulated. Add a checklist item for data classification sign-off.

Maria (Partnerships): Good point. I'll add a legal checkpoint and a short blurb for marketplace listing compliance.

Jon (Eng): Operational concerns: backpressure and replay. If Delta Share sync misses a schema field, connector should log schema diffs and retry after manual approval. Suggest `--dry-run` mode for first deploy.

Keiko (Solutions): Also capture perf expectations: sample throughput numbers (rows/sec) for different instance types and a table for recommended batch sizes. I'll draft those.

Anil (ML): For evals, include a simple quality-check routine: sample 100 vectors after ingestion, compute recall@10 against a small test set. If delta > threshold, trigger rollback.

ConnectorBot: Action items created: #1012 schema matrix draft (Maria), #1013 transform code sample (Jon), #1014 chunking guidance (Keiko), #1015 legal classification checkbox (Priya).

Maria (Partnerships): Timeline: draft ready for review in 5 business days. Can everyone ACK? :spiral_calendar:

Jon (Eng): ACK. I'll add the code sample to the repo and a small integration test.

Keiko (Solutions): ACK. Will add chunking examples and customer-facing FAQ.

Anil (ML): ACK — will supply quantization notes and the eval script.

Priya (Legal): ACK, will draft the language for data flows and compliance items.

Maria (Partnerships): Great. Final ask: if anyone has a partner contact (Snowflake PM / Databricks PM / Qdrant eng lead) pls drop their email in this thread so I can loop them into the design review.

Jon (Eng): I have Snowflake PM: kevin.snow@example.com and Qdrant eng lead: lina@qdrant.io.

Keiko (Solutions): Databricks contact: dbx-partners@example.com.

Maria (Partnerships): Perfect—I'll set up the review for next Wednesday. Thanks all. :rocket:
